metadata.title: Monochromatic Figure Collage with Distressed Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, all-over pattern of hand-drawn female figures in various poses, rendered in dark blue ink outlines on a white background, overlaid with a single, bold, horizontally centered word in distressed red lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red text against blue-white background
Repetitive organic forms creating a textured field
Distressed, eroded type texture versus clean ink line work
Horizontal text anchor against a chaotic, non-linear background
coreInvariants: Dark blue ink line work for figures
Vibrant red for the central text
Black bars covering the eyes of all figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The background is a non-hierarchical collage of figures of similar scale; the text is the primary focal point, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red typography acts as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red text and radiates outward to explore the intricate, repetitive line work of the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is used within the figures to define form and prevent the collage from becoming a solid mass.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white and blue; high saturation contrast between the monochrome background and the red text.

letterConstructionRules: Significant erosion and 'grunge' texture applied to edges and interiors
Horizontal stretching of the overall word
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear as if stamped with uneven ink
Internal voids and 'noise' within the letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface dominance; no secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky proportions and provides a base for distressing.
Captures the eroded, stamped aesthetic naturally.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense, all-over collage pattern of hand-drawn female figures in dark blue ink line art on a white background. Figures should be in various sitting and lying poses, overlapping each other. Every figure must have a small black rectangular bar covering their eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the center in a large, bold, distressed red sans-serif font. The text should have a weathered, stamped texture with rough edges.

verificationChecks: Are all eyes covered by black bars?
Is the text centered and vibrant red?
Is the line art dark blue on white?
Is the background a dense, overlapping collage?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red text distress
Line weight of the ink drawings
mustRedesign: Specific facial features (must be generic line art)

mustAchieve: Balanced chaos in the background pattern

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no figures are isolated; they must overlap.
Confirm the red text is legible despite the distress.
Check that the blue ink color is consistent throughout the background.
Verify the white background remains clean and not muddy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a monochromatic line-art pattern background with a single, high-contrast, distressed typographic element centered as the primary focal point.
